test: Fire Plow held on stone creates source lava and release aborts progress

environment.isolation: fresh HORIZON_HOME, HORIZON_LAUNCHER_HOME, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR; audio disabled

steps: Loaded the rebuilt Horizon host and API 0.5 ftbsbc component; startup reported one running mod and no load error.
Equipped ftbsbc:fire_plow in survival and aimed at minecraft:stone.
Held use for a short interval, released, and inspected the target; it remained minecraft:stone.
Held use on the same stone for a longer interval and inspected the target; it became minecraft:lava[level=0].
scope_limit: The default hold threshold is currently provisional (100 ticks). Control wait timing is not an exact per-tick measurement. Original-game comparison, exact duration, durability, sound/particles, and multiplayer behavior remain unverified.
